stages.label: Inbox
stages.description: New tickets, waiting for a free slot.

stages.label: Plan
stages.description: The planner turns the ticket into a concrete plan.

stages.label: Build
stages.description: The builder implements the plan on the ticket's branch.

stages.label: Check
stages.description: The checks in config.json run on the branch. No reviewer sees a failing build.

stages.label: Review
stages.description: The reviewer reads the diff against the plan and records why the change was made.

stages.label: Done
stages.description: Reviewed, journaled, and ready for you to merge.
